title: AEF 1.0: runner capability manifest
description: What a runner is and can do: its identity, kind, platform, the providers it supports and its tags. A plan's runnerSelector is matched against the tags.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this document follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

runnerId.description: The runner's id; the events and runs it produces name it (PLAN-6).

identity.description: The runner's workload identity, and the id of the key it signs sealed evidence with, if any.

signingKeyId.description: The id of the key the runner signs sealed evidence with: a hint for a reader, never a reason to trust the key (PLAN-6, SIG-4).

kind.description: What the runner is: local (a local process), remote (a remote service), ci (a CI job) or pool (a pool of runners) (PLAN-6).

os.description: The runner's operating system: linux, windows or macos (PLAN-6).

runtime.description: The runtime the runner runs on (PLAN-6).

providers.description: The providers the runner supports. It refuses a plan whose provider is not among them (PLAN-7).

tags.description: The runner's tags. It can take a plan only when it carries every tag of the plan's runnerSelector (PLAN-7).

gpu.description: Whether the runner has a GPU (PLAN-6).

networkZone.description: The network zone the runner runs in. A remote-zone plan needs it to be the plan's zone (PLAN-7).

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).
